text:
marie: Heads up — the JS starter that targets edge runtimes is throwing TS errors for folks using NodeNext style tsconfigs. Small repro attached.

marie: Error: 
```
TS2345: Argument of type 'unknown' is not assignable to parameter of type 'string'
at createClient<T = any>(opts: CreateOptions<T>): Client
```

devon: This smells like overload resolution + differing generic defaults. When we ship multiple overloads (one with T = any and another with T = unknown) TS can pick the wrong one depending on how the consumer resolves package exports. NodeNext/Node16/bundler differences change which entry point types get merged.

owen: Repro steps I used: fresh project, tsconfig with module=NodeNext and moduleResolution=NodeNext, install ts types, run `tsc --noEmit`. Fails. If I change to moduleResolution=bundler + module=ES2022 it passes.

marie: For a quick unblock I added `skipLibCheck: true` to the sample tsconfig and it stopped erroring for newcomers. Not ideal but reduces onboarding friction.

devon: Longer term ideas: 1) add a single flattened d.ts for edge consumers (package.json `types.edge` or `exports.types` path) that avoids overlapping overloads; 2) export a non-overloaded factory like `createClientForEdge<T = unknown>()` so inference is deterministic; 3) prefer `unknown` in public surface and document why (safety + forcing explicit casts where appropriate).

owen: Also saw a parity bug where the ESM/edge bundle is dropping our auth/retry side-effect shim during rollup tree-shake, causing token refresh 401s in the sample. CJS sample still works. Workaround: explicitly import the compat file in the sample entry: `import '@redwood/sdk/compat/auth-retries';`

ci-bot: Issue created: #1203 (sdk: types/edge) assigned to @devon, labels: bug, sdk, types, edge

docs-bot: Suggested doc blurb: "If you are targeting edge runtimes, prefer tsconfig { module: 'ES2022', moduleResolution: 'bundler', skipLibCheck: true, resolveJsonModule: true }. See SDK note about unknown vs any for rationale."

devon: Action items: add CI compile job for the edge starter under NodeNext + bundler pipelines; add flattened typings path; add non-overloaded edge factory export; add a short changelog entry explaining unknown default.

marie: I'll open two PRs: one small PR updating the sample tsconfig + README note, and one follow-up linking the issue to add the edge typings entry. Thanks everyone. :sparkles:
